author: v220-final-deploy
findingAddressed: round1 deployment P2: both upstream readiness and official core download lack whole-operation timeouts; original finding/reproductions preserved unchanged.
implementation: proxy_core.network_deadline uses a one-shot SIGALRM only on the Linux manager main thread. An already active/periodic ITIMER_REAL is rejected before handler/timer changes or network I/O; no nested timer rescheduling.
Every _fetch open, redirect, DNS/connection/TLS/header and response body read is enclosed by one 300-second deadline. Each official object fetch retains its separate existing byte and origin budgets.
Upstream readiness uses one 12-second deadline across CONNECT/TLS/HEAD and complete response headers. Per-socket timeouts remain a secondary bound.

Timeout raises sanitized DeployError without retry. Response/connection finally blocks and timer/handler restoration run, and the existing selected-transaction compensation restores old configuration/core/activity.

windows.boundary: Signals are substituted for portable contract tests; Windows is explicitly unsupported for production deadline networking.

linuxRoot.boundary: Real Linux root files, local socket/urllib and SSL/TLS. nft/systemd/service IO remain isolated substitutes in transaction cases.

download: official-allowlist redirect then slow response headers; one alarm allocation across both requests
upstream: slow HEAD response headers over locally trusted real TLS
successful CONNECT/TLS/HEAD through the same path
cleanup: peer threads/listeners closed; generated fixture TLS key removed with temporary directory

verification.selectedFailure: Dedicated root transaction case injects proxy_timeout only after candidate selection, then checks exact old snapshots/core/activity and absence of pending recovery.

historicalFixtureFailure.reason: The new TLS fixture replaced the global http.client.HTTPSConnection class and broke Python3.12 explicit super name resolution before networking. Production was not implicated.
historicalFixtureFailure.correction: Patch only service_proxy own http module view; real standard-library HTTPSConnection remains unchanged. One TLS method with four phases passed first, then final platform admission refinement passed the exact complete affected root/portable selection.

limitations: No main-instance action, systemd/nft change, official download, upstream VLESS request, external DNS, paid model or full-suite run.
Download tests route the real urllib HTTP parser and production redirect handler through loopback HTTP; real TLS coverage belongs to the upstream readiness fixture, not live GitHub.
Wall-clock termination is tested with a 0.25-second configured budget and a 1-second assertion margin; this is not a five-minute production-duration test.
The original round1 audit remains NONCLEAN. This author report is not a new full-repository audit.
